name: Measure-Theoretic Probability
description: Put probability on measure theory and make martingales and change of measure rigorous.

lessonNames.l13-stopping-times: Stopping times and optional stopping proved
lessonNames.l15-likelihood-ratios: Likelihood ratios as changes of measure

lessonObjectives.l1-why-measure: See why not every set can have a probability, with a uniform pick from an interval.
lessonObjectives.l2-sigma-algebras: Check the sigma-algebra axioms and generate the Borel sets.
lessonObjectives.l3-measures: Build a probability space and prove continuity from above and below.
lessonObjectives.l4-measurable-functions: Define a random variable as a measurable function, and its distribution as a pushed-forward measure.
lessonObjectives.l5-lebesgue-integral: Build expectation as a Lebesgue integral from simple functions.
lessonObjectives.l6-monotone-convergence: Use the monotone convergence theorem to swap a limit and an expectation.
lessonObjectives.l7-dominated-convergence: Use dominated convergence to differentiate a price under the expectation.
lessonObjectives.l8-modes-of-convergence: Tell almost sure, in probability, in mean square and in distribution apart.
lessonObjectives.l9-information: Read a sigma-algebra as what is known, using a coin-flip tree.
lessonObjectives.l10-condexp-projection: Define conditional expectation as a projection and prove the tower property.
lessonObjectives.l11-filtrations: Model information that grows over time with a filtration, and tell adapted from predictable.
lessonObjectives.l12-martingales-defined: Prove a process is a martingale with respect to a filtration.
lessonObjectives.l13-stopping-times: Prove the optional stopping theorem under bounded stopping times.
lessonObjectives.l14-radon-nikodym: Reweight a probability with a density and compute expectations under the new measure.
lessonObjectives.l15-likelihood-ratios: Use a likelihood ratio for importance sampling of a rare loss.
lessonObjectives.l16-girsanov-on-a-tree: Change the up probability on a tree and track the drift it removes.
lessonObjectives.l17-risk-neutral-rigorous: Show that discounted prices are martingales under the risk-neutral measure.
